company.shortDescription: DoorDash is a food delivery platform that connects customers with local and national businesses.
company.description: Doordash provides restaurant food delivery services connecting customers with local businesses. The company is passionate about transforming local businesses and is dedicated to enabling new ways of working, earning, and living. By building the last-mile delivery infrastructure for local cities  Doordash is bringing communities closer. It connects customers with their favorite local and national restaurants and Fang, Evan Moore, Stanley Tang, and Tony Xu launched the company as PaloAltoDelivery.com in 2013, which became DoorDash, Inc. in October 2014.

aiResearchSummary.text: DoorDash is researching systems for improving last-mile delivery of real-time, on-demand orders for perishable goods, as described in Hybrid autonomy system for autonomous and automated delivery vehicle and Automated vehicle for autonomous last-mile deliveries. Efforts also include Optimized order fulfillment from multiple sources, which uses machine learning to allocate orders, and System and Method for Dynamic Pairing Function Optimization, focusing on pairing orders with couriers. These areas highlight advancements in autonomous delivery, order optimization, and courier assignment.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Debt round raised $2,750,000,000, or 52.66% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 14 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $700,000,000 to $16,000,000,000, a 22.86x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 99 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 79 (+16).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Uber Eats, Grubhub, SkipTheDishes.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
